line: Crowley's Princess of Disks: the Hé final of the Name, the earthy part of Earth, and a quadrant of the heavens that the table alone names.

sections.title: The court and its element
sections.line: Crowley names the Princesses by the Hé final of the Name.

quotes.quote: The Princesses represent the Hé final of the Name.
The Princess of Disks, the last of the Court cards, represents the earthy part of Earth.

sections.title: Its place in the heavens
sections.line: Princesses have no zodiacal attribution. The attribution table names a quadrant of the heavens about Kether (pdf p274); the text names none, so no quotation stands for it.

quotes.quote: The Princesses have no Zodiacal attribution.

sections.title: Its character as Crowley describes it
sections.line: Crowley's description of the figure and the card, in his own words.

quotes.quote: Her crest is the head of the ram, and her sceptre descends into the earth.
she is Womanhood in its ultimate projection
